form_name: Domestic Travel Report (attached to an approved request)
note: Documentation only - NOT wired into FORM_REGISTRY: this is not a standalone AppFrm-XXX document type, it is travel_report_write.php?doc_id=<approved AppFrm-023 doc_id>&approve_type=AppFrm-023&pop=Y, writing onto the request's own record. The registry's FormType -> single appFrmCode/templateFile shape doesn't fit an attached sub-page, so src/forms/travel-report.ts and src/tools/ipk-submit.ts submitDomesticTravelReport define this field set inline; this file exists only as a readable record of the live-confirmed DOM, same convention as the other form_templates/*.json files. Confirmed live 2026-10-09.

doc_id.note: the approved request's own doc_id, from the URL

report_post.note: never guessed - empty unless IPK_USER_POSITION is set

report_leader.note: never guessed - empty unless IPK_GROUP_LEADER is set

report_dest.note: prefilled from the request; NOT a form input to fill

purpose_field.note: >=100 chars, enforced by the page's own Check_Form()

agenda_field.note: >=100 chars, enforced by the page's own Check_Form()

result_field.note: >=100 chars, enforced by the page's own Check_Form()

gift_p.note: default N, not set by submitDomesticTravelReport

gift_r.note: default N, not set by submitDomesticTravelReport

submit_flow.note: Only save control confirmed live is '[ Draft ]' -> javascript:Check_Form('D'); no final-submit button was present on the page actually inspected. No subject/start_day/end_day/pdoc_id fields exist here - compare form_templates/AppFrm-076.json for the separate standalone overseas-report form.
